scope: Synthetic irreversible crosslinking, common prefix, equal actual dose per port. No wet data used.
target_selection: The 16 point development-only corner screen selected the middle dose and the earlier deadline. Kept the previous study's 0.28–0.41 lead window. Absolute conversion bounds and between-action 0.015 are illustrative, not wet requirements.
late_companion_analysis: Repeat structural feasibility using the same numeric target evaluated at 8.0; this is a different checkpoint, not a different control or a sensitivity on selected actual decisions.
noise_units: Independent Gaussian per channel. The Sobol points integrate this sensor uncertainty, not material replication.
comparators: Fixed development action; development-fit sign of bound difference; local free-only, bound-only, pooled both; all four local reads posterior or direct quadratic. All fit on the same simulator development bank and choose by pass probability, then mean miss.
terminal_scope: Terminal metrics are conversion fractions, not measured stiffness. Equal terminal windows and pairwise equivalence are reported separately. Same per-port integrated uptake follows the assumed flux boundary.
